preservation: Keep all historical notes, values, gate booleans, stop rules, statuses and verdicts unchanged. In particular unmeasured endpoints stay unmeasured; their historical FAIL booleans are not evidence of measured failure. Scope exclusions create no new mandatory gates on unrelated rows. No unexpected original debt identified or added.
limits: This review approves only the exact bound candidate interpretation content. It does not rerun evidence, complete missing endpoints, promote deployment/product/hardware/human acceptance, reconcile budgets, authorize GPU/model/scientific work, or authorize native writes. Parent alone owns separately authorized writes and must revalidate live fields; null proposal modes must not clear newly present metadata.
